name: step_inc
summary: Increment step tensor by +1 elementwise. Inputs: (S), Outputs: (SO). Supports int32, any-rank including scalar(0d). For rank>0 requires contiguous; scalar(0d) relaxes contig. In-place allowed (SO may alias S). No attrs, no workspace.
contract: Inputs: 1 tensor S. Outputs: 1 tensor SO.
Semantics: SO[i] = S[i] + 1 for all elements (scalar treated as 1 element).
Shape: S and SO must have same rank and identical shape; scalar rank==0 allowed.
Layout: if rank>0 then both must be contiguous; if rank==0 contiguity is not required.
Aliasing: in-place allowed (SO.data may equal S.data).

variants.name: step_inc_i32
notes: Kernel writes SO in-place; host side does not need S.data for the update when SO aliases S.
If SO is out-of-place (different buffer), current kernel still only updates SO; caller must have copied S->SO beforehand if it expects SO==S+1.

suites.name: correctness
suites.desc: Verify +1 behavior for scalar and tensors; check out-of-place semantics expectations.

cases.setup: initialize S with values, initialize SO with zeros (no copy)
cases.notes: This reflects current kernel semantics: it increments SO only. If you want true out-of-place, add a second kernel or change kernel to read S and write SO.

pitfalls: 현재 커널은 입력 S를 읽지 않고 outputs[0]만 +1 합니다. 그래서 out-of-place를 허용하려면 (1) 런처에서 S->SO memcpy를 먼저 하거나, (2) 커널 시그니처를 (S, SO)로 바꿔서 SO[i]=S[i]+1로 만들어야 합니다.
rank==0 scalar를 'contig 무시'로 처리하지만, 실제 TensorDesc 구현에서 0d stride/contig 값이 어떻게 채워지는지에 따라 check 로직이 더 단순해질 수도 있습니다.
